senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אוּת)to be becoming, handsome.

units: <cite ref="Sukkah 10a:14">Succ. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>לנָאוֹתָהּ</he> to decorate it (the Succah); a. e.

<cite ref="Nazir 2b:8">Naz. 2ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>ואנוהו</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 15:2">Ex. XV, 2</cite>) <he>אֶנָּאֶה לפניו וכ׳</he> I will adorn myself before him with good deeds; <cite ref="Shabbat 133b:5">Sabb. 133ᵇ</cite> <he>הִתְנָאֶה וכ׳</he> adorn thyself before him &c.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 26a:10">R. Hash. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>חוטא בל יִתְנָאֶה</he> a sinner must not adorn himself (when appearing before the Lord to ask forgiveness).

Gen. R. s. 16 (play on נִינְוֵה) שהם מִתְנָאוֹת מישראל (not מתגאות) they (the goverments) adorn themselves with what they take from Israel; a. e.—V. נָוָה I.—2) (cmp. הָנָה Nif., a. אוּת) to be pleased, to enjoy, make use.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 11a">R. Hash. 11ᵃ</cite> beautiful trees <he>להִתְנָאוֹת בהן בני אדם</he> (Ms. M. <he>לֵיהָנוֹת מהן</he>) for men to enjoy their beauty.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 21b:19">Snh. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא יתנאה בשל וכ׳</he> that he make no use of a copy that his fathers have written; (Tosef. ib. IV, 7 <he>שלא יהא ניאות</he>).
